summary: Verified i18n bug fix for public wellness form (LoadManager Pro). Tested both English (token JSUT58) and Portuguese (token V2ZD3V) flows via /athlete-token -> /athlete-wellness. Form labels, sliders, placeholders, submit button, and success modal (title, Readiness/Prontidão, status badge, Recommendations list, Finish/Finalizar) all render in the coach/token language with no mixed-language leftovers. Submission returned 200 in both cases and success modal shown with correct recommendations in the correct language.
critical_code_review_comments: Same athlete (Carlos Novo) was able to submit under both tokens — expected since 'already answered' is per-token; no bug, just a note.
Web build uses native <select> not exposed as <select> DOM (react-native-web renders custom), but default first athlete pre-selected worked fine for submission.
test_credentials: Pre-generated tokens JSUT58 (EN coach) and V2ZD3V (PT coach) worked as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n bug fix verified end-to-end. EN form body: 'Wellness Questionnaire / Fill in to monitor your recovery / Select your name: / Date / Sleep hours / Sleep quality (Poor-Excellent) / Fatigue (None-Extreme) / Muscle soreness (None-Severe) / Pain Location + Example: Right Hamstring / Stress (Relaxed-Very stressed) / Mood (Poor-Excellent) / Submit Questionnaire'. EN success modal: 'Questionnaire Submitted! / Readiness / Moderate / Recommendations: / Consider improving your sleep hygiene / Finish'. PT form: 'Questionário de Bem-Estar / Preencha para monitorar sua recuperação / Selecione seu nome / Data / Horas de sono / Qualidade do sono (Ruim-Excelente) / Fadiga (Nenhuma-Extrema) / Dor muscular (Nenhuma-Muita) / Local da Dor + Exemplo: Posterior da Coxa Direita / Estresse (Relaxado-Muito estressado) / Humor (Ruim-Excelente) / Enviar Questionário'. PT success modal: 'Questionário Enviado! / Prontidão / Moderado / Recomendações: / Considere melhorar sua higiene do sono / Finalizar'.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: form used device locale. Fix confirmed working: /athlete-token now passes lang=<coach language> as route param to /athlete-wellness; tc(key)=i18n.t(key,{locale: coachLang}) forces coach language. Backend /token/submit builds recommendations in token language.
